title: Tensor multiplication with a closed-immersion kernel section
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], and $L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Use the chosen tensor-pullback adjunction unit $\eta_d:L^{\otimes d}\to j_*j^*(L^{\otimes d})$ [def-pc-module-pullback, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction, lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation], and put $K_d=\ker\eta_d$. For all $a,d\geq0$, every open $U\subseteq X$, every $s\in\Gamma(U,L^{\otimes a})$ and $y\in\Gamma(U,K_d)$, there is $z\in\Gamma(U,K_{a+d})$ whose image under the kernel inclusion equals the canonical tensor-power multiplication applied to $s\otimes\iota_d(y)$. No square-zero assumption or quotient action is required.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses: tensor-power ideal kernels; kernel comparison from Tag 08KS, modules-lemma-i-star-equivalence.

proof.text: Use boundaryIdealKernelIso and boundaryIdealKernelIso_exists to identify K_d with J tensor L^d and K_(a+d) with J tensor L^(a+d), with their inclusion equations. These proved ideal-kernel comparison APIs in SquareZeroTensorBoundaryComparisons are documented under lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit and require no square-zero hypothesis.

Construct L^a tensor K_d to K_(a+d) by whiskering the inverse degree-d comparison, the inverse associator, the braiding exchanging L^a and J, the associator, the ideal whisker of tensor-power multiplication, and the degree-(a+d) comparison. Associator, braiding and unitor naturality identify its composite with the kernel inclusion with multiplication after the source inclusion; ideal_tensor_shuffle proves this calculation. Evaluate on tmulSection s y and apply whiskerLeft_app_tmulSection. Unit coherence covers a=0, d=0 and a=d=0; the same construction applies to the empty open.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorKernel_section_product {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (a d : ℕ)
    (U : X.Opens) (s : Γ(L.tensorPow a, U))
    (y : Γ(kernel (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow d)), U)) :
    ∃ z : Γ(kernel (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow (a + d))), U),
      (kernel.ι (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow (a + d)))).app U z =
        (L.tensorPowAddIso a d).inv.app U
          (tmulSection s ((kernel.ι (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow d))).app U y))
